title: Page designer: a list-view block has no inspector fields, so its row cap (dataSource.limit) can only be set in JSON
body:
## Source

Found by the #26613 card thread (PR #26700, out-of-scope finding), checked by the ui seat on `origin/main` `43731031`.

## Problem

PR #26700 makes a `list-view` block in a wide page region show only its first `dataSource.limit` rows (5 when none is set). The page designer cannot set that number. `BLOCK_CONFIG` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` is a hand-curated table. It has entries for `object-grid`, `object-kanban`, `element:repeater` and others, but none for `list-view`. A `list-view` block selected in the page editor therefore shows no typed fields. "Advanced" lists only keys the block already has, so an author cannot add `limit` there either (see that file's header comment).

## Target

Add a `list-view` entry to `BLOCK_CONFIG`, following `element:repeater` (`block-config.ts:344-350`), which already edits `dataSource.limit` with `kind: 'number', at: 'dataSource'`. Include at least `object` (object-picker, `at: 'dataSource'`), `view` (`at: 'dataSource'`) and `limit` (number, `at: 'dataSource'`, placeholder `5`), with labels as keys in `../i18n.ts` (#3913).

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts`, the inspector i18n keys in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, tests beside, one changeset. No `packages/spec/**` change: `dataSource.limit` is already declared on the page element binding.

## Acceptance

A test: selecting a `list-view` block in the page inspector shows an editable limit box, and editing it writes `dataSource.limit` on the node.

Related: #26613, PR #26700.
